Partial tuition waiver, costs for visa and insurance

Radboud University has announced the Radboud Scholarship Programme 2018. This scholarship will provide an opportunity to the outstanding non-EEA students to pursue a complete English-taught Master's degree programme at Radboud University.
In order to be eligible for this scholarship, an applicant must-
Not eligible for the lower EEA tuition fee for other reasons.
Have obtained a Bachelor's degree achieved outside the Netherlands and must not receive any previous education in the Netherlands.
Have been fully admitted to the English-taught Master's degree programme starting September 1, 2018.
Be enrolled at Radboud University as a full-time student for the academic year and Master's degree programme for which the scholarship will be awarded.
In order to apply for this scholarship, follow the steps given below-
Click on the desired Master's programme.
Create a request for enrolment in
As soon as a request for enrolment will be created in Studielink, an email will be sent to the registered email id containing personal login details for the ORISIS Application System.
The application form must be completed within 56 days of creating enrolment.
One has to ask the university to provide an official statement that states the candidate likely to be a graduate before 1 September in case of not obtaining the diploma.
An official transcript of Bachelor's degree or equivalent.
In case of not obtaining the degree, send the list of grades received so far.
Sworn translations of diploma and transcript.
Translations are not required if your diploma and transcript are in Dutch, English or German.
The applicant must be able to comply with the conditions for obtaining a visa for the Netherlands.
A handling fee of EUR 75 needs to be paid for English-taught Master's programmes. The handling fee for Business Administration is EUR 150. For more information regarding Handling fee, click
The scholarship includes a partial tuition waiver and pays for costs for visa and insurance.
It also covers costs such as those for visa, residence permit, health insurance and liability insurance (Insurance Passport for Students (IPS)).
